entries.failure: PC1 tracked the MHC region instead of ancestry; association results were confounded.
entries.explanation: The HLA/MHC region (chr6:25-35Mb, hg19) has long-range LD; unless excluded before pruning/PCA, its dense block dominates the leading components. Same for chr8 inversion (8p23) and chr17 inversion (17q21). Standard fix: exclude long-range LD regions (Price et al. 2008) before pruning and PCA.

entries.failure: Half the variants failed to merge or matched the wrong position; effect sizes were nonsense for those.
entries.explanation: Two inputs on different genome builds (hg19 vs hg38) or different chromosome naming ('chr1' vs '1'), or 0-based BED vs 1-based VCF coordinates. Always assert build and coordinate convention before merging.

entries.failure: Strongest hits were all on one genotyping plate.
entries.explanation: Plate/batch effect confounded with case-control status (cases genotyped later). Check case/control balance per batch; include batch or regress it out; palindromic A/T C/G SNPs with strand flips add to this.

A feature computed after the outcome (e.g. 'days_since_last_claim', an aggregate that included the target row, or a post-outcome status flag) leaked into training. Also: splitting after de-duplication or time-ordering leaks near-duplicates across folds.

entries.failure: A 4% lift that vanished on re-analysis.
entries.explanation: Events double-counted after a join on a non-unique key (one user, many sessions) inflated the treated group. Assert uniqueness of the join key before aggregating; compute the lift per unit of randomization.

entries.failure: Dose-response curve flattened at the top after dropping incomplete records.
entries.explanation: Missingness depended on the outcome (sickest patients had missing follow-up). Complete-case analysis is biased under MNAR; describe the missingness mechanism, use multiple imputation or sensitivity analysis.

entries.failure: Top differentially expressed genes were the sequencing lane.
entries.explanation: Library batch confounded with condition. Design the experiment so batch and condition are balanced; include batch in the model; check PCA coloured by batch before DE.

entries.failure: Forecast off by 10x for one region.
entries.explanation: One data source reported revenue in thousands, another in units; a currency/fiscal-calendar change mid-series had the same shape. Assert units per source and plot the raw series per source before modelling.

entries.failure: Pipeline crashed in production on a category never seen in training.
entries.explanation: One-hot encoder fitted on training levels only; a new level appeared at inference. Use handle_unknown='ignore' or map rare levels to 'other' with a threshold, and test the pipeline with an unseen level.

entries.failure: Mean income was 12 because most rows silently became NaN.
entries.explanation: A spreadsheet export wrote '1,234' and ' 12 ' into a numeric column; pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce') turned them into NaN without a word. Assert dtypes on load and count coerced values.
